entities.name: Vial Smasher
entities.description: A legendary goblin berserker of Tarkir's Kolaghan clan who handles and smashes vials of dragonfire; in the original timeline she was Yasimin Ankleshank.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who considered her a clan-mate and friend in the original timeline.

entities.name: Mardu Horde
entities.description: Clan in which she was a clan-mate of Sarkhan in the original timeline.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: The clan of Tarkir to which Vial Smasher belongs.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane Vial Smasher traveled to through an Omenpath.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: Akul's group, which Vial Smasher joined.

events.summary: Vial Smasher traveled to Thunder Junction through an Omenpath and joined Akul's Hellspurs.
events.quote: where she became a member of Akul 's Hellspurs

relations.note: She joined them at Thunder Junction.
relations.quote: where she became a member of Akul 's Hellspurs

relations.note: In the original timeline he considered her a friend.
relations.quote: had considered her a clan-mate in the Mardu Horde and a friend
